title: Scaling and evaluating sparse autoencoders
benchmark_measurement: The paper uses a probe-based evaluation suite that includes tasks on moral philosophy concepts such as deontology, utilitarianism, virtue, and justice. It does not directly measure religious beliefs, bias, or knowledge.
models_tested: a series of models sharing GPT-4 architecture
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study. The main findings relate to the scaling laws of sparse autoencoders, methods for training them reliably, and new metrics for evaluating the quality of the learned features.
